svg.title: Contribution city — one building for each calendar day
svg.desc: 704 contributions over 371 calendar days; 96 active days; best day 64 contributions. Each building is a day. Height uses a capped logarithmic scale; color follows GitHub contribution levels. Exact date and count appear in every building's title.
svg.text: A living skyline, built from the days the work happened.
Height follows a capped log₂ scale. Color follows GitHub activity levels.
371 dated cells · GitHub calendar · refreshed 19 Sep 2026 · 04:43 UTC
